wiki.title: Counselor Tyra
wiki.text:
Counselor Tyra is a human NPC that can be found in the perimeters of Camp Chatty, located in the Greenwood Forest.

She is also an enemy NPC in Bigfoot Defender. She is with Jake, Edmond, and Kaela to find and hurt Bigfoot.

Quests
Quest:Defensive Strategy (repeatable)
